items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’d probably take a book of the writings of Edgar Allen Poe, simply because I’m very interested in that.

ctx.x: . . . based out of Dayton, Ohio, a classical chamber ensemble.

So that gives – I’ve written several other ballets, but the main ballet is Masque of the Red Death, which I will probably turn into a suite. It’s based on Edgar Allen Poe’s [story, The] Masque of the Red Death.
